tagline: Buys often, spends high, bought very recently
who: Best customers. High frequency, high spend, active now.
typical: Recent order within ~3 weeks; ~44 orders lifetime; ~₹60M revenue; ~18+ orders/year
strategy: Priority service • Loyalty recognition • Early access to new products • Dedicated account care
avoid: Treating them like average accounts; slow response; stockouts on their usual products

tagline: Strong spend and frequency; still active
who: Core of the revenue base. Reliable, high value, not quite Champion recency.
typical: Last order ~1.5 months ago; ~39 orders; ~₹50M revenue
strategy: Maintain service levels • Cross-sell Class A lines • Periodic relationship reviews
avoid: Neglect after Champions get all the attention

tagline: Mid-range on all three; room to move up
who: Large group with average recency, frequency and spend. Can become Loyal or slip to At Risk.
typical: Last order ~2 months ago; ~34 orders; ~₹43M revenue
strategy: Targeted offers • Bundle Class A products • Engagement campaigns • Monitor recency drift
avoid: One-size-fits-all messaging; ignoring early signs of slowing orders

tagline: Used to buy; activity has slowed
who: Below-average frequency and spend; recency stretching out (~3 months).
typical: Last order ~2.5–3 months ago; ~31 orders; ~₹37M revenue
strategy: Win-back outreach • Check service/delivery issues • Special reactivation offer • Assign owner
avoid: Waiting too long; only contacting when they place a tiny order

tagline: Long time since last order; low lifetime value
who: Lowest R, F, M. Last order often 5+ months ago. Smallest revenue contribution.
typical: Last order ~5 months ago; ~29 orders; ~₹34M revenue
strategy: Cheap digital win-back • Confirm if still in business • Do not invest heavy account time
avoid: Expensive personal outreach with low expected return
